The Sabrent Rocket 4 Plus doesn't replace the SSD inside your PS5 but expands the storage via Sony's purpose-built SSD expansion slot. This isn't a hack or a modification, just a relatively easy upgrade. The reason you would expand the SSD internally rather than running an external SSD via the USB ports is because you cannot run PS5 games directly from these USB drives but you can run PS4 games from them.
